Much like '''DuelMania WorldWide''', there had been a lot of work going on behind the scenes getting everything ready for DuelMania's first ever LAN tournament, where {{player|dev|flag=br}} worked hard for this to happen. The hype was real, and bragging rights to the most important LAN 1on1 tournament since the [[True Gamers Invitational|TGi]] along with the one-of-a-kind ''DuelMania QuakeCon 2016 Champion's Trophy'' was at stake. 

===Format===
* Seeded Double Elimination
* Only open to those who competed in the [[QuakeCon 2016|QuakeCon TDM 2on2 QuakeWorld Tournament]].
